speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection.

The clinical picture of acute watery diarrhea and cramping starting two days after initiating levofloxacin therapy for pneumonia is highly suggestive of *C. diff* colitis. Please proceed with the Stool Toxin A/B assay and Stool PCR for *C. difficile*.
